scenicChapters.title: Jura Crest Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 62 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-le-grand-lac-de-clairvaux-le-cret.story: 250 km from Clairvaux-les-Lacs to Clairvaux-les-Lacs, about 4 h 19 of riding. The stops in between: Bourg, Le Crêt de Chatillon and back through Bourg. The highest point is about 1,000 m. It crosses from France into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
